preserve: All v7/v7.1 records, source holds, corrections and genuine v4 capture unchanged; no promotion/inversion or revised old forecast
book_admission: All strict pairedOver/Under full-game four documented NFL markets; exact native ESPN→historical GSIS/team/week; closing_point only; bothclosing_at strictly before both source and original C kickoffs; opening<=closing; identical duplicates collapsed; multiplethresholds/conflicting same-side/identity held. No main/alternate claim. Labellookup independent from forecast role filter. No outcome-based admission. Same rules as v7; inventory frozen before prediction lookup.

void_note: Apply the sensitivity symmetrically to every arm/category/book and preserve excluded IDs. No source VOID→DNP or statisticalwin→settled wager inference.

rankings.rule: Rank each P2/P3 own selected-side win probability descending; tie by kickoffUTC,gameID,GSIS,category,offerID; one GSIS/player per weekly list; no forcedK. Include valid probabilities with unknown later outcome in candidate universe and membership; technicalunavailable/ties remain excluded with reasons. OverOnly/UnderOnly filter own selected sides, not forced inversion.

diagnostics.market_reference_gate: Exact matching closing_point, identical side observation time, paired compatibleprices and documented same market OPEN state. Missingstate is N/A, no manufactured no-vig market.
diagnostics.P1_confidence: Use same retained law probability for its OWN chosen mean/median side, including below50%; never substituteP2 side.
